videos.title: Criminal Minds
videos.description: The BAU takes charge of a hostage situation at a law firm where Matt Simmons' wife works.

videos.title: FBI: Most Wanted
videos.description: Remy and the team investigate the homicides of two Army veterans in a murder spree connected to their time in Afghanistan; Hana receives surprising news about her birth mother.

videos.title: MacGyver
videos.description: Los Angeles' power grid is taken hostage in a ransomware attack resulting in a citywide blackout; the team discovers the ransomware code used was written by Riley years ago.

videos.title: MacGyver
videos.description: When Mac is put into a dream state to help him recall key evidence found in Nikola Tesla's secret lab that could stop Codex's deadly plot, he encounters Nikola Tesla, Alexander Graham Bell, Thomas Edison and his mother.

videos.title: MacGyver
videos.description: Mac is placed inside a fake prison cell with a top Codex operative, "The Merchant," to gain his trust and get intel on their next move.

videos.title: FBI: Most Wanted
videos.description: The team pursues an abusive man who is on the hunt for an ex-girlfriend trying to escape him; Jess and Sarah make plans to take their dream vacation together.

videos.title: FBI: Most Wanted
videos.description: The team must track down a murderous member of the incel community targeting those he believes never give him a chance; Barnes, Hana, Ortiz and Kristin deal with their grief in the wake of Jess' death.

videos.title: FBI: Most Wanted
videos.description: The team gets called to Vermont after a married couple who grow illegal marijuana massacre their employees; Barnes begins to regret not taking any time off to bond with her new baby.

videos.title: FBI: Most Wanted
videos.description: Charming but formidable Supervisory Special Agent Remy Scott arrives to lead the team as they investigate a series of homicides tied to a forbidden love between a young teen and her older boyfriend.

videos.title: FBI: Most Wanted
videos.description: Remy and the team investigate the homicides of two Army veterans in a murder spree connected to their time in Afghanistan; Hana receives surprising news about her birth mother.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: Booth and Brennan probe what appears to be a case of jealousy and insurance money when a man is found dead at a construction site, but new clues send them in a different direction.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: Brennan and Booth investigate an explosion in a Miami hotel where a young woman had burned to death.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: Brennan and Booth investigate a young beauty queen's remains that are discovered at a water filtration plant; Hodgins asks Angela out on a date, which she accepts.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: The skeletal remains of a federal prosecutor, who disappeared five years earlier, are discovered in the desert outside Las Vegas; an anonymous lead takes Booth and Brennan to the world of gambling and underground ultimate fighting.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: Booth and Brennan search for a killer who buries his victims alive and leaves them to die if ransom demands are not met.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: Brennan and Booth investigate when a headless corpse appears in the woods along with a frightening videotape of events on the night of the murder.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: Brennan and Booth investigate the case of a mutilated body found on the roof of a federal building; Brennan hears from her long-lost father.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: A body Brennan and Booth think is that of Brennan's incarcerated adversary, serial killer Howard Epps, is burned beyond recognition.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: After Booth's gun is taken away because he maliciously shot a clown ornament on an ice-cream truck, Brennan must go to Florida alone to investigate the death of a college student whose body is found inside an alligator.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: The Bancroft family calls on Brennan and Booth to investigate the stabbing death of Terence Bancroft; Agent Sullivan invites Brennan to his basketball game.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: During a murder investigation at the marina, Booth notices similarities between the case and a murder in Brennan's latest book.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: Booth interrupts Brennan's vacation with her boyfriend to get help with the case of a woman whose boneless body was found in a river.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: When a water main bursts at a cemetery, Brennan must identify and help reinter the remains that litter the grounds.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: Booth suspects an organized-crime family when a partial skeleton is found encased in concrete, and he tries to lure the suspected killer out of hiding; Brennan gets a surprise visit from her father (Ryan O'Neal) while visiting her mother's grave.

videos.title: Bones
videos.description: When Brennan and Booth investigate a body that was found in a crater, evidence suggests that it had been in outer space.

videos.title: NCIS: New Orleans
videos.description: The team investigates the murder of a Navy intelligence officer killed during a conference for foreign diplomats; Pride has some trouble adjusting to his new position at the agency.

videos.title: NCIS: New Orleans
videos.description: An investigation into the murder of a petty officer reveals a conspiracy in a tight-knit local fishing community; LaSalle awaits the final results of the tax fraud investigation into his family's company.

videos.title: NCIS: New Orleans
videos.description: Pride's father, Cassius Pride, is wrapped up in an NCIS case involving a notorious unsolved casino heist; Pride meets a family member he never knew existed.

videos.title: NCIS: New Orleans
videos.description: After Pride's assistant escapes from a kidnapper, the team uncovers evidence of a suspect who is harvesting organs from multiple victims; Pride turns to a friend for guidance as he struggles with the ramifications of his recent brush with death.

videos.title: NCIS: New Orleans
videos.description: Following a deadly car explosion in the French Quarter, the team interrogates a professor and former member of a student protest organization; Tammy discovers a secret about Hannah's personal life.

videos.title: NCIS: New Orleans
videos.description: The team places Mateo Diaz, a high school gang member turned informant, in protective custody while they investigate the murder of his junior reserve officers' training corps instructor; Pride needs his brother's help to gain Mateo's trust.

videos.title: NCIS: New Orleans
videos.description: The team investigates the murder of a Navy contractor who secretly lived two lives for decades.

videos.title: NCIS: New Orleans
videos.description: Pride is given a series of tasks to complete by unknown assailants who are holding Wade and his father hostage.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: A murdered man's body may hold the key to a 20-year-old case involving a kidnapped girl whose father never stopped looking for her.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: Adam investigates the murder of an undercover FBI agent who was about to wed the daughter of a Yakuza leader; Noelani is held hostage and forced, along with her mentor Dr. Chu, to operate at gunpoint on a criminal.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: McGarrett helps his sister spy on her shady neighbors; a ride-share driver and his passenger are murdered; the team teases the youngest members when Junior escorts Tani to a wedding.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: Fugitive hacker Aaron Wright resurfaces to ask for help when his co-workers at the NSA are murdered; Junior speaks at the parole hearing of the drunken driver who killed his sister.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: Five-0 continues to hunt down escaped criminal Aaron Wright before he can sell cyber-weapons to the highest bidder; the lives of McGarrett and the team members are put in danger when a visitor comes to headquarters to make amends.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: A new ally helps McGarrett and the team when mob bosses on the island are targeted by an assassin; the team says goodbye to one of its own.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: Tani and Junior must plot an escape for themselves and several civilians after they become trapped inside a deadly tunnel collapse; Eddie the dog sniffs out a bomb that has been planted in McGarrett's home.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: A plane that mysteriously crashed into the Pacific in the '80s is found, but with a recently murdered scuba diver inside; McGarrett and Quinn zero in on who planted the bomb in his garage; McGarrett formally asks Quinn to join the team.

videos.title: Hawaii Five-0
videos.description: Five-0 enlists imprisoned hacker Aaron Wright to help when a young girl is reported kidnapped.
